The actual source close pre-hook emits no_promise/service_error; all products remain open, notes dispatched is zero, and source close transitions to end. The stop is bounded and fail closed for promises but still violates required per-product notes. No HTTP close occurred.

findings.title: DOB punctuation causes complete canonical answers to be discarded
findings.detail: With a correct canonical v=1987-04-17 scalar and complete supplied raw DOB, standalone 17 April nineteen eighty-seven!, 17.04.1987, and 1987-04-17? stay in dob and make no verify_identity call. The source replaces the valid extracted value with security_raw whenever raw is nonempty. self_answer does not strip final ! or ?, and numeric parsing excludes dotted separators. Minimal answer-only confirmations reproduce all three failures without administrative question rows. Trailing period/slash controls pass. Missing years, wrong subjects and hypothetical input remain blocked; hyphenated century grammar and complete independent-question examples pass.
findings.suggestion: Normalize unambiguous terminal sentence punctuation and complete numeric DOB separators while retaining explicit-year, subject and quote checks; never invent a year.

findings.title: A claimed span naming one product can authorize paid notes for siblings
findings.detail: A deliberately scope-contaminated paid row with sub=self/claim=current_bank/pol=positive/mode=asserted, p=all and exact x=I already paid my credit card passes bank_claim. explicit uses any matching target, then accumulate expands to all targets. All three products become paid. The follow-up runs actual source add_note hooks with three synthetic successful receipts, recording paid notes for all products and closing paid. Likewise a p2,p3 row naming only car loan marks both loans paid. Producer instructions prohibit this wrong scope; this is a negative guard witness, not a conforming customer-policy failure or observed hosted extraction. It is an actual source disposition-write guard gap, so an unqualified clean financial-authority admission is not supported.
findings.suggestion: Require the asserted claim span to support every resolved target, or explicit collective bank-product scope, before expanding a paid/dispute row. Preserve sibling facts and neutral clarification rather than importing raw numeric financial terms.
